title: Junior Core Mathematics • Objective Mastery Series (Set 37)
subject: Mathematics

questions.prompt: Which of the following represents the complete set of factors of $18$?
questions.hint: List all whole numbers that divide 18 without leaving a remainder.

questions.prompt: Two disjoint sets $A$ and $B$ have no members in common. Which of the following statements correctly describes their relationship?
questions.hint: Disjoint sets have an empty intersection.
questions.workedSolution: When two sets have no elements in common, their intersection is the empty set: $$A \cap B = \emptyset$$.

questions.prompt: Kofi is $36\text{ years}$ old. Kwame is half as old as Kofi. Kwabena is $8\text{ years}$ older than Kwame. How old is Kwabena?
questions.hint: Find Kwame's age first: $36 \div 2 = 18$. Then add 8.

questions.prompt: How many lines of symmetry does a non-square rectangle have?
questions.hint: A non-square rectangle has horizontal and vertical axes of symmetry.
questions.workedSolution: A rectangle has exactly 2 lines of symmetry connecting the midpoints of opposite sides.

questions.prompt: Which of the following numbers is NOT a prime number?
questions.hint: Check for factors other than 1 and the number itself.
questions.workedSolution: $$15 = 3 \times 5$$, so 15 is a composite number, not a prime number.

questions.prompt: If the domain of $x$ is $$\{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}$$, find the truth set of $$3x + 2 < 11$$.
questions.workedSolution: $$3x < 9 \implies x < 3$$. The values in the domain strictly less than 3 are 1 and 2.

questions.prompt: In how many years will a principal of $\text{GH¢ } 6,000.00$ yield a simple interest of $\text{GH¢ } 1,200.00$ at a rate of $4\%\text{ per annum}$?
Make $k$ the subject of the relation: $$h = p - \frac{r}{k}$$.
questions.hint: Isolate $\frac{r}{k} = p - h$, then take the reciprocal.

questions.prompt: Which property of arithmetic operation is illustrated by the statement: $$x(y + z) = xy + xz$$?
questions.workedSolution: The equation illustrates the distributive property of multiplication over addition.

questions.prompt: Simplify: $$12^8 \div 12^6$$.
If $$\frac{1}{y} = 2\frac{1}{2}$$, find the value of $y$.
Calculate the size of each exterior angle of a regular pentagon ($5\text{ sides}$).
questions.hint: Sum of exterior angles is $360^\circ$. Divide by 5.

questions.prompt: Factorize completely: $$x^2 - 7x + 12$$.
questions.hint: Find two numbers whose sum is -7 and whose product is +12.

questions.prompt: Kofi, Ama, and Kwaku shared a profit of $\text{GH¢ } 720.00$ in the ratio $1 : 5 : 3$ respectively. How much did Ama receive?
Use the difference of two squares identity, $$a^2 - b^2 = (a + b)(a - b)$$, to evaluate $$78^2 - 22^2$$.
What is the probability of obtaining an even number when a fair six-sided die is thrown once?
questions.hint: Even numbers on a die are {2, 4, 6}. Total outcomes = 6.

questions.prompt: The test scores of eight students in a contest are: $$10, 14, 18, 12, 18, 9, 11, 18$$. What is the probability that a student picked at random scored $18$?
questions.hint: Score 18 occurs 3 times out of 8 total scores.

questions.prompt: Express $18$ as a percentage of $72$.
Find the value of $k$ given that $$k = (2^7 \div 2^4) \times 8$$.
Express $0.005128$ in standard form.
questions.hint: Move the decimal point 3 places to the right to obtain 5.128.

questions.prompt: Given that $x = 3$ and $y = 4$, evaluate: $$(2x + y)(x - 2y)$$.
Which inequality is represented on a number line by a closed circle at $-2$ and an open circle at $3$ connected by a solid segment?
questions.hint: Closed circle includes the point ($\le$), open circle excludes it ($<$).
questions.workedSolution: Closed at -2 means $x \ge -2$; open at 3 means $x < 3$. Combining gives $$-2 \le x < 3$$.

questions.prompt: A sector of a circle of radius $14\text{ cm}$ subtends an angle of $90^\circ$ at the centre. Find the perimeter of the sector. (Take $\pi = \frac{22}{7}$).
In an isosceles triangle $ABC$, $|AB| = |BC| = 10\text{ cm}$ and base $|AC| = 16\text{ cm}$. A perpendicular line from $B$ meets $AC$ at $D$. Find the altitude $|BD|$.
Write $\text{GH¢ } 48,760.00$ correct to the nearest thousand Ghana Cedis.
questions.hint: The hundreds digit is 7, which is $\ge 5$, so round up the thousands place.
questions.workedSolution: Rounding 48,760 to the nearest thousand gives 49,000.

questions.prompt: Solve for $x$ in the equation: $$3x + 4 = 5x - 8$$.
Evaluate: $$\left(\frac{3}{4} - \frac{1}{3}\right) \div \frac{5}{12}$$.
A hiker walks on a bearing of $045^\circ$. What is his back-bearing (bearing of the starting point from the destination)?
In an enlargement with centre at the origin, point $A(2, 3)$ is mapped to $A'(-4, -6)$. What is the scale factor of the enlargement?
If $$23_x = 13_{\text{ten}}$$, find the base $x$.
How many vertices does a rectangular cuboid have?
questions.hint: A cuboid has 6 faces, 12 edges, and 8 corner vertices.

questions.prompt: Factorize completely: $$px - 3py + qx - 3qy$$.
Four masons can build a boundary wall in $6\text{ hours}$. How long would it take $12\text{ masons}$ working at the same rate to build the wall?
In an equilateral triangle, each interior angle has a measure of:
questions.hint: Sum of angles in a triangle is $180^\circ$. Divide by 3.

questions.prompt: How many faces does a standard cube have?
questions.hint: Think of a standard playing die.
questions.workedSolution: A cube has exactly 6 square faces.

questions.prompt: State the rule for the linear mapping where inputs $x = \{1, 2, 3, 4\}$ produce outputs $y = \{4, 7, 10, 13\}$.
questions.hint: Common difference between outputs is 3. When $x = 1$, $3(1) + 1 = 4$.
questions.workedSolution: Slope is 3. For $x = 1$, $3(1) + c = 4 \implies c = 1$. The rule is $$x \to 3x + 1$$.

questions.prompt: In a right-angled triangle, one acute angle measures $38^\circ$. What is the size of the other acute angle?
questions.hint: The two acute angles in a right-angled triangle add up to $90^\circ$.

questions.prompt: A trapezium has parallel sides of length $11\text{ cm}$ and $9\text{ cm}$. If its area is $70\text{ cm}^2$, find its perpendicular height $h$.
The mean of the numbers $5, 7, 8,$ and $x$ is $8$. Find the value of $x$.

A discrete distribution is given by the table below:

| Value | 2 | 4 | 6 | 8 |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Frequency | 8 | 12 | 15 | 5 |

What is the probability of selecting the value $6$?
